scope: This authorizes a bounded TRAIN-only support assay and conditional four-update learning diagnostic. It does not activate the complete candidate study or permit held-out selection before data clearance.
reason: Placeholder-free reasoning request produced only6 valid canonical labels in64 sampled outputs, with1 exact correct and1 useful group outside the frozen400. A separate fixed8 TRAIN pre-warmup direct-answer diagnostic had8 valid outputs and2correct. Different images and decoding prevent attributing an accuracy difference to prompt; the paired prospective assay tests this interface confound.

warmup.endpoint: Exactly400 completed one-prompt SFT updates on frozen400, fixed final endpoint only; no partial adapter adoption
warmup.gain_attribution: All warmup gains are SFT, and every subsequent arm/reference shares this final adapter.
warmup.exposure_caveat: Current warmup400presentation count is configuration-derived; it predates actual-ID exposure instrumentation. Do not describe it as a recorded training trace.

data.train_membership: Exactly the selected 400 IDs, including any common warm start; no trainval merge, external task labels, synthetic class ambiguity, pseudo-label dataset, or teacher rationales.
data.canonical_vocabulary: Exact complete ordered canonical_labels from the selection plan; never restrict choices to classes represented in a diagnostic batch.
data.preprocessing: Decode RGB, reject unexpected EXIF orientation, remove bottom20 rows once, then use the frozen native processor. No GT-box crop, label-bearing filename in prompt, or model-specific underlying pixels.
clearance_before_heldout_learning_select: Author-original byte equivalence for candidate images verified against the sole archive.
Complete cross-split ID and decoded-pixel audit recorded; any unresolved duplicate policy fixed before scoring.
All3333 native validation images ready under the shared transform.
data.test_status: SEALED: no task-selection, prompt, reward, hyperparameter or checkpoint selection using test.
data.dataset_terms: Non-commercial research only; retain provenance and publish download instructions rather than image files.
data.claim_scope: Fourshot gradient training with disclosed development exposure; no claim against full-data SFT, challenge-leaderboard parity, or absence of pretraining contamination.

profiles.name: reasoning_v2
profiles.instruction: Inspect the aircraft’s visible distinguishing features. First give a brief explanation of the visible details, enclosed by <think> and </think>. Then write one label copied exactly from the allowed list on its own line. Do not add a prefix, quotes, or any text after that label.

profiles.name: answer_only_v2
profiles.instruction: Return one label copied exactly from the allowed list on its own line. Do not add a prefix, quotes, explanations, or any text after that label.

sampling.reference: Same completed common warm adapter hash and model/processor identity in every invocation; no optimizer updates in assay.

reward: Exactly 1 iff the completion terminates with EOS and parses as the exact canonical gold label; otherwise 0. Optional bounded think block and bare/tagged label follow the shared parser.

per_profile_gate.useful_mixed_group: Contains at least one EOS-terminated valid correct canonical label AND at least one EOS-terminated valid but incorrect canonical label. Correct-versus-invalid-only groups do not qualify.

selection_rule: If reasoning_v2 passes every per-profile gate, select reasoning_v2.
Otherwise, if answer_only_v2 passes every per-profile gate, select answer_only_v2 and name the method task-only token RL; do not claim a reasoning mechanism.
If neither passes, preserve outcomes and stop this recipe. Any capacity or objective change requires a separately identified prospective experiment; no unlimited resampling or warmup extension.

conditional_learning.scope: Four real GRPO optimizer updates and matched SFT from shared warm adapter on eligible frozen400 TRAIN data; bounded mechanism demonstration, not validation improvement
conditional_learning.reward_and_reference: Exact task-only reward; copied immutable warm-adapter reference beta0.04. Record initial current-reference mismatch, sampled/teacher logprobs, actual task-gradient/parameter movement, finite outputs, timing and exposure.
conditional_learning.same_prompt_control: Strict matched SFT uses the selected RL prompt; stronger answer-only SFT search remains required for any later substantial claim.
conditional_learning.diagnostic_weights: Never silently adopt diagnostic weights as full-study initialization.

unchanged_final_requirements.units: Absolute fractions, so0.05 means five percentage points; all conjunctions must pass.

substantial_rl.validation_replicates: Seed 42 passes. Across seeds 42, 314 and 2718, mean paired RL-minus-corresponding strongest SFT delta is at least 0.05 and each delta is greater than zero. Final test uses predeclared seed 42; do not hide failed seeds.

named_frontier_comparison.baseline_quality_gate: At least0.95valid EOS-terminated outputs on the comparison split; otherwise diagnose interface failure and make no visual-superiority claim. Preserve exact failures in score regardless.
named_frontier_comparison.arithmetic_headroom: A baseline above 0.90 leaves less than the required 0.10absolute margin. Do not weaken the comparator to create headroom.

unchanged_final_requirements.relative_error_reduction_formula: (accuracy_RL-accuracy_comparator)/(1-accuracy_comparator); undefined at comparator 1.0 and the margin is then unattainable.
unchanged_final_requirements.interpretation: These are ambitious project acceptance proposals, not literature-derived expected results. Passing only code tests, a TRAIN gate, a small subset, one weak SFT comparison, or a gain below these margins is insufficient.
unchanged_final_requirements.final_claim: Require substantial-RL validation and replication gates, then the corresponding native-test RL and named-baseline gates. Frontier discovery is a feasibility screen, not an achievement gate. Name the exact baseline, quantization, dataset, shots and split; do not generalize one local open-weight win to all frontier models.

reporting: Retain every completion, raw token ID, EOS/invalid flag, exact label and reward under both prompts and both seeds.
Report per-profile groups and costs separately, never best-of-G as pass@1.
No model/manual TEST access; original-image and full cross-split clearance remains required before held-out learning selection.
This TRAIN assay does not prove recognition generalization, faithful reasoning or a frontier win.
execution_freeze: Trainer owner must additionally bind exact source/environment, warm adapter SHA, selected32 manifest, full prompts and supervisor limits before launching. This amendment fixes the scientific comparison now.
